# Kamath Residency

> Kamath Residency is a 40-room nature resort in Nagothane-Raigad, specializing in corporate outings, family getaways, and group events near Mumbai and Pune.

Located in the Raigad district between Mumbai and Pune, Kamath Residency offers adventure activities, team-building experiences, and weekend retreats with facilities including discotheque, ATV rides, and mountain biking at Kolad. The resort caters to families, corporate teams, and group outings in the Western India region.
